text:
Grok Bot 0.71.2 is out, and this is a very huge upgrade

You can now send files up to 250 MB, and videos up to 1 GB. Full-length clips, raw footage, long recordings, big reports and heavy PDFs can go straight to Grok Bot without compressing, trimming or splitting anything first

You can also send up to 20 files in a single message. Drop an entire batch of photos, screenshots or documents at once and let Grok Bot work through all of them together

Notifications are smarter, so you hear about what actually matters, when it matters

And forms now arrive pre-filled. Grok Bot fills in what it already knows, so you just check and confirm instead of typing everything again

This update is really good
